pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sati karaṇīye senaṃ gantvā atirekatirattaṃ senāya vasanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā senāya vasissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.5: amhākaṃ pi alābhā amhākaṃ pi dulladdhaṃ ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu puttadārassa kāraṇā senāya paṭivasāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atirekatirattaṃ senāya vasissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave atirekatirattaṃ senāya vasathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā atirekatirattaṃ senāya vasissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.15.1: siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocid eva paccayo senaṃ gamanāya, dvirattatirattaṃ tena bhikkhunā senāya vasitabbaṃ. tato ce uttari vaseyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.1.1: siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocid eva paccayo senaṃ gamanāyā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.1.3: dvirattatirattaṃ tena bhikkhunā senāya vasitabban ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.1.6: catutthe divase atthaṃgate suriye senāya vasati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.2.1: atirekatiratte atirekasaññī senāya vasati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.3.4: dve rattiyo vasitvā tatiyāya rattiyā purāruṇā nikkhamitvā puna vasati,
